raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.descriptionHtml:
About Meadow

Meadow is the modern payments platform for higher education that simplifies the entire student financial experience. We're transforming the $600 Billion higher education payments industry in the United States — building for universities what Shopify built for retail businesses, and bringing the entire student financial experience online.

The need for a platform like Meadow has never been greater. If you're passionate about our mission to empower students financially and strengthen economic mobility through higher education — and you're excited to join a highly ambitious, talented team — we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Overview

Meadow is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale our student financial engagement platform, Meadow Pay. As we continue expanding to universities nationwide, this role will be critical in delivering reliable, scalable product experiences for our institutional partners and their students.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate core systems across our backend and frontend stack, partnering closely with Product, CX, and Integrations to deliver high-quality software. This role requires strong technical judgment, a high bar for quality, and a desire to take ownership of meaningful product areas from concept through production.

AI tooling (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex, etc.) is a core part of how our team works and ships code every day. We're looking for a Software Engineer who is excited to use AI as a core part of their workflow. The ideal candidate should have experience building products in a way that AI tooling can efficiently understand context and collaborate with the user.

What You'll Do

  • You'll lead end-to-end development of product features from design through deployment and ongoing support.

  • You'll architect and build scalable backend services and APIs (TypeScript/Node.js).

  • You'll contribute to frontend development using modern frameworks (React preferred).

  • You'll design systems with reliability, observability, and maintainability in mind.

  • You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, CX, and Integrations teams to deliver customer-facing functionality.

  • You'll participate in code reviews and uphold high standards for code quality and system design.

  • You'll improve engineering processes, tooling, and documentation to support scale.

  • You'll help shape technical decisions and engineering culture as we grow.

About You

What You Bring

  • 5+ Years of Experience in Software Engineering

    • Experience Building & Operating Production Systems at Scale

    • Strong Backend Development Experience (TypeScript/Node.js Preferred)

    • Experience Building Modern Frontend Applications (React Preferred)

    • Experience with Relational Databases and Writing Performant SQL Queries

    • Familiarity with Cloud Infrastructure (AWS Preferred) & Modern Deployment Practices

    • Strong Understanding of Monitoring, Logging, and Observability Best Practices

  • Builder Mindset: High Agency x High Urgency

    • You own problems end-to-end.

    • You make consequential decisions that impact outcomes.

  • Proven Success Communicating & Collaborating w/ Product, Design, Engineering & Non-Technical Stakeholders

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience at an Early Stage Startup

  • Experience in FinTech (Or Other Regulated Industries)

  • Familiarity with Payment Systems and/or Financial Infrastructure

  • Experience Designing/Integrating Systems with External Partners or APIs

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full-time position. Meadow wants all employees to be supported in their personal and professional development, so we take a comprehensive approach to compensation and benefits. The initial annual salary for this position is expected to range from $148,750-$215,000. Actual compensation will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, knowledge and skills, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors.

In addition to the chance to positively impact the world while building a company around a $600B opportunity, Meadow offers:

  • Competitive Salary

  • Competitive Equity

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

  • Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (with HSA & FSA Plans Available)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 1-2 Onsites Per Year

  • Membership in an Ambitious, Kind, No-Drama Team

We believe in hiring resourceful, curious people who are eager to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with the job description, we encourage you to go ahead and apply. You may be just the right candidate for this role.

Meadow is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in all its forms, and we encourage our employees to participate as their authentic selves in our work environment. We strive to build better for all, towards a more open, inclusive space. Come as you are.

About Meadow

Meadow is the modern payments platform for higher education that simplifies the entire student financial experience. We're transforming the $600 Billion higher education payments industry in the United States — building for universities what Shopify built for retail businesses, and bringing the entire student financial experience online.

The need for a platform like Meadow has never been greater. If you're passionate about our mission to empower students financially and strengthen economic mobility through higher education — and you're excited to join a highly ambitious, talented team — we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Overview

As a Product Designer at Meadow, you'll partner with other Product Designers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to conceptualize and ship product that powers the student financial experience.

Design at Meadow is AI-first and builder-led. We're looking for a Product Designer who is excited to 1) use AI as a core part of how they design — prototyping early, testing with real customers, and staying involved through launch and iteration, and to 2) design for AI — building products that assume the system can understand context, take initiative, and collaborate with the user.

What You'll Do

  • Own Product Work End-to-End: You'll work in lockstep with Product and Engineering to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, and ship product.

  • Prototype Using AI Tools: You'll use Cursor and Claude Code to build and iterate on flows and interactions, then partner with Engineering to turn them into production-ready designs.

  • Polish Validated Concepts Using Figma: You'll translate validated concepts into Figma for full state coverage, system alignment, and production readiness.

  • Build Meadow's Product Design Practice: We're a small team of builders who thrive on ownership. As our second Product Designer, you'll help shape Product Design at Meadow from the ground up.

About You

What Your Bring

  • 4+ Years of Experience in Product Design

  • Proven Success Owning Projects from Problem Definition → Launch & Iteration

  • Proven Success Communicating & Collaborating with Engineering and Product

  • Portfolio Showcasing Strong Product Thinking, Interaction Design, and Craft

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience at an Early Stage Startup

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, FinTech (or Other Systems-Heavy Environments)

  • Active Use of AI Tools in Your Design Workflow (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor)

Location

Meadow is a remote-friendly organization with offices in New York, NY and San Mateo, CA, and we're currently seeking candidates based in the United States. With that said, our Chief Product Officer (Nathan) and Senior Product Designer (Amanda) choose to work from Meadow's New York, NY Office 3-5+ Days/Week — and we welcome candidates who are interested in working in-person alongside them! Please note that Meadow does not currently offer relocation support and/or visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full-time position reporting to the Chief Product Officer. Meadow wants all employees to be supported in their personal and professional development, so we take a comprehensive approach to compensation and benefits. The initial annual salary for this position is expected to be $124,950-$206,000 USD. Actual compensation will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, knowledge and skills, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors.

In addition to the chance to positively impact the world while building a company around a $600B opportunity, Meadow offers:

  • Competitive Salary

  • Competitive Equity

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

  • Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (with HSA & FSA Plans Available)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 1-2 Onsites Per Year

  • Membership in an Ambitious, Kind, No-Drama Team

We believe in hiring adaptable, curious, and fast-learning people who are eager to develop their skills every day. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with the job description, we encourage you to go ahead and apply. You may be just the right candidate for this role.

Meadow is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in all its forms, and we encourage our employees to participate as their authentic selves in our work environment. We strive to build better for all, towards a more open, inclusive space. Come as you are.

  • You'll document our integration processes and solutions to support scalable growth.

  • Advanced Knowledge of SQL, Scripting Languages (e.g. PowerShell, Bash), DNS, Networking, and SFTP Protocols.

  • Builder Mindset: High Agency x High Urgency

    • You own problems end-to-end.

    • You make consequential decisions that impact outcomes.

  • Customer-First and Solutions-Oriented Mindset

About Meadow

Meadow is the modern payments platform for higher education that simplifies the entire student financial experience. We're transforming the $600 Billion higher education payments industry in the United States — building for universities what Shopify built for retail businesses, and bringing the entire student financial experience online.

A strong outbound motion and top of the funnel engine are the lifeblood of Meadow’s revenue growth. We’re at an exciting inflection point: Our enterprise sales motion is working, demand is growing quickly, and we’re ready to scale the top-of-funnel engine that will power our next chapter. Today, our team is a talented group of 10 BDRs — currently managed by our COO — who have proven what’s possible, and are ready for dedicated leadership, structure, and a high-performance cadence. The team is already successful and has the potential to do so much more.

We’re looking for a Director of Business Development who can take an established motion and level it up — coaching and developing SDR talent, increasing productivity across the team, leveraging tooling and partnering with Marketing to build the systems and processes that will consistently generate qualified pipeline for our AEs.

If you’re energized by building a world-class Business Development Team and pipeline engine, and creating a high-output culture that directly fuels revenue growth, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Overview

The Director of Business Development will play a fundamental role in building a world-class outbound pipeline generation engine at Meadow.

Your mission is to level up the Business Development Team so that we can increase quotas as a lever — as opposed to always increasing team size — through a data-driven approach to coaching, a close examination of our current practices and messaging, and a willingness to build whatever is needed to ensure success.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • You'll lead and scale our outbound team (10 BDRs).

  • You'll deliver significant hands-on coaching (e.g. Daily Call Reviews, 1:1s, Role Plays, Objection Handling, etc.).

  • You'll build a high-performance culture rooted in clear expectations and accountability.

Strategy, Process & Execution

  • You'll own outbound playbooks (e.g. Segmentation, ICP Targeting, Outreach Strategy, Talk Tracks, Qualification, Handoffs, Follow-Up Loops, etc.).

  • You'll establish operating rhythms (e.g. Campaign Reviews, Enablement Sessions, etc.).

  • You'll own the partner with Marketing to translate campaigns into meetings, and with AEs to ensure tight conversion and feedback loops.

Data, Tooling & Continuous Improvement

  • You'll define and manage KPI systems end-to-end (Activity → Conversations → Meetings → Qualified pipeline → Closed-Won Contribution

  • You'll build dashboards and reporting in HubSpot, and identify bottlenecks and drive targeted improvements.

  • You'll forecast pipeline generation and capacity needs, including territory/segment planning and quota modeling.

  • You'll drive adoption of modern tooling and workflows (e.g. Sequencing, Call Intelligence, Enrichment, Scoring, QA, etc.)

  • You'll pilot AI-enabled strategies, like intelligent lead scoring, personalization at scale, call coaching workflows, etc.

  • You'll continuously test and iterate on messaging, channels, sequences, and enablement content, then standardize what works.

What Success Looks Like

  • ⬆️ Average Meetings Booked and Completed Per BDR; 2x — or more! — Per-SDR Productivity

  • ⬆️ Meeting Quality, Resulting in Higher Closed-Won Rates for AEs

  • Standardized Processes and Playbooks Published (e.g. New BDR Onboarding, Prospect Outreach, etc.)

About You

Must-Haves

  • You’ve led 5-10 BDRs at a startup.

    • You have a track record of success measurably improving per-SDR productivity metrics (e.g. # Meetings Booked, Conversion Rates, etc.). You bring an analytical approach and have opinions based on experience.

    • You have a track record of success coaching and developing SDRs, helping them perform at a higher level through feedback and mentorship.

  • You’re a data-first operator. You’ve built, maintained, and iterated on dashboards and systems that informed high-quality decision-making.

  • You’re a practical AI adopter. You use AI to increase BDR effectiveness, not for hype.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full-time position reporting to the COO. Meadow wants all employees to be supported in their personal and professional development, so we take a comprehensive approach to compensation and benefits.

The initial annual On-Target Earnings (OTE) $200,000-$250,000 (OTE = 70% Base Salary + 30% Variable). This range represents the low and high end for a position based in San Francisco, CA. Actual compensation will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, knowledge and skills, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

In addition to the chance to positively impact the world while building a company around a $600B opportunity, Meadow offers:

  • Competitive Salary

  • Competitive Equity

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

  • Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (with HSA & FSA Plans Available)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave
